Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, you can cancel an order, but timing is critical. Orders can be canceled before they are shipped or processed. Once your item has shipped, your order cannot be canceled — it will be considered a return and is subject to our return policies.
Here's what to expect:
Processing time: Cancellation requests are processed in the order they're received and may take up to 3 business days to complete, though most are handled more quickly.
Confirmation: You'll receive a confirmation email within about 24–72 business hours once the cancellation is processed.
Refunds: Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically processed within 7 business days, though exact timing depends on your bank's processing times.
Important note: If your order has already shipped or is prepared for shipment, shipping fees are non-refundable since Avocado incurs round-trip shipping fees.
